claims.content: To understand how the customer base is behaving, where to focus segmentation efforts based on the identification of the best customers in aggregate, and to give an idea of how the customer base is trending over time — specifically whether they are spending more or less, purchasing more or less often, etc.

claims.content: Business Owner
The RFM (Recency, Frequency, & Monetary) analysis report system is available and configured for use by Business Owners.
Customer transaction data including purchase dates, order amounts, and account identifiers are populated in the system to enable recency, frequency, and monetary calculations.
The user has selected a timeframe for the report via radio buttons: either 'lifetime' (all available sales data) or 'past 12 months'.
The Recency section tiers (0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, over 365 days) are defined and ready to segment accounts based on last purchase date.
Calculated fields for revenue per account, orders per account, and % of total accounts within each tier are enabled and will be computed upon report generation.
The Business Owner initiates the RFM (Recency, Frequency, & Monetary) analysis report to understand customer base behavior and segmentation trends.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner initiates the RFM (Recency, Frequency, & Monetary) analysis report to understand customer base behavior and segmentation trends.

claims.content: The Business Owner selects the desired timeframe for the RFM report using radio buttons: either 'lifetime' (all available sales data) or limiting to the past 12 months.
The system generates the RFM report, splitting the Recency section into six tiers: 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, and over 365 days.
For each recency tier, the system displays the total number of accounts that made a purchase transaction in that time range, along with revenue and order amounts.
The system calculates and displays fields including revenue per account, orders per account, and percentage of total accounts within each recency tier.
The Monetary and Frequency sections use the same columns as the Recency section, applying identical tier structures to display spending and purchase frequency metrics.
The final row of the report provides totals for each column across all tiers.
The RFM (Recency, Frequency, & Monetary) analysis report has been generated and displayed to the Business Owner.
The Recency section of the report is split into six tiers: 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, and over 365 days.
For each recency tier, the total number of accounts that made a purchase transaction in that time range is shown, along with revenue and orders amounts.
Calculated fields including revenue per account, orders per account, and % of total accounts within each tier are included in the report output.
The final row of the report shows the total for each column across all tiers.
The Monetary and Frequency sections use the same data columns as the Recency section, with identical tier structures applied.
The report reflects the timeframe chosen by the user — either 'lifetime' (all available sales data) or limited to the past 12 months.
